details:
Project Details – FlameSafe AI

FlameSafe AI is an AI-powered research platform designed to make space fire-safety research easier to explore, understand, and use. It addresses the challenge of accessing and interpreting complex scientific information about fire behavior in microgravity, where flames behave differently from those on Earth.

The platform brings NASA's fire-related research and experimental findings into an interactive experience. Users can explore relevant investigations, ask questions in natural language through an AI research assistant, and access research-based answers linked to their original sources. This helps users navigate scientific information more efficiently, discover relevant findings, and better understand the differences between combustion in microgravity and on Earth.

The project's main benefit is making complex research more accessible and reducing the time needed to find and understand relevant scientific evidence. Its intended impact is to support researchers, engineers, and future space-mission planners in making better-informed decisions related to spacecraft fire safety and human space exploration.

What makes FlameSafe AI creative is its combination of conversational AI and structured scientific research exploration. Instead of simply presenting a collection of research papers or data, it aims to provide an interactive way to investigate questions, connect findings to their sources, and explore scientific evidence.

During development, our team considered scientific reliability, source traceability, accessibility, clarity of information, and the importance of distinguishing research-supported findings from information that is not available in the sources. We also considered the unique challenges of fire behavior in microgravity and the safety requirements of future space missions.
